note: ppu_lifter.py --insn-hooks: gowa_poll_wait (poll_wait.cpp) at the heads of the main thread's polling loops, the launcher's cheats (cheats.cpp) on a creature's damage

hooks.note: func_0049D688: until the least of seven u16 progress counters the SPU jobs raise reaches a target
func_0049B35C: until func_0049CB6C finds the counters it waits for
func_0044CD20: the job-graph scan (func_0044CA48) until its entries are done
func_0044D120: the same scan, from its other caller
func_0041D4E8: until the u16 at [*(r30 + 0xC)] + 0xE0 reads 0 (15% of the main thread in the first level)
func_00087440, a creature's damage: r3 the creature, f1 the damage, negative to heal
func_00156680, a hit: its call of func_00087440, with r31 the attacker, r3 the victim and f1 the damage
func_00154460, a hit from a message: the same call, the same registers
